mapper.select:
select id, stock_date, s.machine_code, m.machine_name, material_code, bar_code, stock_num, remark, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from t_cd90_line_side_stock s left join ( SELECT m.machine_code, max(m.machine_name) machine_name FROM t_cd90_machine_info m WHERE m.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY m.machine_code ) m ON m.machine_code = s.machine_code where del_flag='0'
and stock_date >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startTime},'%Y-%m-%d')
and stock_date <= STR_TO_DATE(#{endTime},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
and INSTR(material_code, #{materialCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
order by stock_date desc
order by ${orderStr}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_cd90_line_side_stock SET del_flag = NULL, update_by = #{userName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, update_time = now() WHERE stock_date = ( SELECT max(STOCK_DATE) FROM MES_CD90_LINESIDE_STOCK@sync_data WHERE DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion} ) AND del_flag = '0'

INSERT INTO t_cd90_line_side_stock ( id, stock_date, BAR_CODE, material_code, machine_code, stock_num, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag ) SELECT null, STOCK_DATE, BAR_CODE, MATERIAL_CODE, MACHINE_CODE, AVAILABLE_STOCK, #{userName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, now(), #{userName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, now(), '0' FROM MES_CD90_LINESIDE_STOCK@sync_data WHERE DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}
